summary.text: Renewable energy is energy made from natural resources that are replenished on a human timescale, most widely solar, wind, bioenergy and hydropower.
Its systems have rapidly become cheaper and more efficient over the past 40 years, and a large majority of new electricity capacity worldwide is now renewable.
The main reason to use it instead of fossil fuels is to cut the greenhouse gas emissions that cause climate change, and it also causes much less air pollution.

facts.label: Needed for net zero
facts.value: 90% of electricity by 2050, says the IEA

items.prompt: Nuclear power plants produce almost no emissions. Why are they usually not counted as renewable?

options.label: They take too long to build
They use too much cooling water
Their uranium fuel is not renewable

items.explain: Renewable energy must come from an endless source, and nuclear power relies on mined uranium, a non-renewable fuel.

items.prompt: A grid operator needs extra power quickly on a still, dark night. Which renewable source can be turned up on demand?
items.explain: Wind and solar fluctuate, while dammed hydroelectricity is a controllable renewable source.

items.prompt: Renewable and low-carbon are not the same thing. Which renewable source can be very carbon-intensive?
items.explain: Burning biomass can be very carbon-intensive if it is not offset by planting new plants.

items.prompt: Renewables rose from 20% to 28% of global electricity between 2011 and 2021. Which sources supplied most of that rise?
items.explain: Power from the sun and wind accounted for most of the increase, growing from a combined 2% to 10%.

items.prompt: A solar farm and a gas plant have the same maximum output. Why does the solar farm usually deliver less energy over a year?

options.label: Solar panels wear out within months
Its source is not available all the time
Solar power cannot enter the grid
Gas plants run at double their rating

items.explain: Solar is intermittent, so it has a lower capacity factor than plants that can produce power whenever the grid needs it.

items.prompt: Oil and gas reserves are concentrated in a limited number of countries. How do renewable resources compare?
items.explain: Renewable energy is more evenly distributed around the world than fossil fuels.
